notes: Gold conversations for Debye's no_hot_water diagnosis (KB: no_hot_water.json). Question ids, answer keys and cause ids are from the KB only; 'gas_smell' is the safety_first emergency path. tenant_facts holds the true answer key for each question this tenant could be asked; the simulated tenant answers from it (a missing key means the tenant can't say). self_help_result ('works' | 'fails' | null) tells the simulated tenant what happens after a 'try this' tip. setup: null | 'notice_on' (notice_12_maint active) | 'luka_boiler_case_open' (open boiler case from c_202 in prop_12). asks counts: a KB question id is a diagnostic question (max 3 distinct per conversation; re-asking the same one after an off-topic reply does not count twice), 'clarify' does not count. Partners: heating and plumbing go to Heizung Schmidt (Vaillant and plumbing skills), electrical to Elektro Klein; caretaker Peter Wolf covers prop_12 only. Consent template: 'Is it okay if I share your name, phone number, address, floor and the photos with <company>?'. 'and the photos' is left out when the tenant sent no photo. After consent, staff approve the visit before it is booked. Tenants never pay for repairs; Debye never promises dates or costs.

conversations.title: Shower went cold after flatmate's long shower

turns.text: my shower went cold halfway through
Let's sort it out. Did anyone use hot water just before or at the same time, like another shower, the dishwasher or the kitchen tap?
yeah my flatmate had a really long shower right before me
Then the hot water tank is probably just empty after that long shower; it reheats in about 30–45 minutes. Try again then and tell me if it works.
ok will try later
Sounds good. I'll check back with you in an hour.

must_not: mention the radiators or the sinks
